author: _Nathy
body:
Hello lads and lasses, welcome to my commentary corner. With my new PC, I hope to make some more commentary videos, especially tournament games, so I thought this would be a nice place to pop some videos up.

Commentary:

Cennet vs Sagrevyum: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WWpM336QHRM
HOME vs Jalapenos scrim: https://youtu.be/TuweyBmZMs8
Mega scrim from February 5: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qrU87Su2WTY&feature=youtu.be

Other Vids:

Cacal are ready for unnoficial tourney: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uv3wuhDb3oY&feature=youtu.be

If you see me on while your team is scrimming, message me, I'd love to come record some more gameplay.


Cheers, Nath
